# ETHIOR WelcomeScore

> WelcomeScore helps maintainers and first-time contributors evaluate public GitHub contributor readiness and developer onboarding signals with evidence-bound guidance. It is an official open-source project by ETHIOR.

## Production Endpoints & Mirrors

- **Primary Cloudflare Production:** https://www.welcomescore.is-local.org/ (and https://welcomescore.pages.dev/)
- **Vercel High-Availability Mirror:** https://welcomescore.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository:** https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore
- **Brand / Publisher:** ETHIOR (https://ethior.com)

- Primary Contributor Readiness Audit: https://www.welcomescore.is-local.org/

- First-party GitHub Action: `ethiorhq/welcomescore-action@v1` (https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore/tree/main/actions/welcomescore)
- Public Report & Schema API: `GET /api/report?repo=owner/repo` (Specification: https://github.com/ethiorhq/welcomescore/blob/main/docs/REPORT_SCHEMA.md)
- DevOps Doctor Diagnostic API: `GET /api/devops?repo=owner/repo`
- Organization Fleet Aggregator API: `GET /api/org/:org`

## What WelcomeScore Does

WelcomeScore by ETHIOR is the all-in-one developer experience, contributor readiness, and DevOps audit engine for public GitHub repositories. Key capabilities include:

1. **Contributor Readiness Audit**: Deterministic 5-pillar scoring checking CONTRIBUTING.md, Code of Conduct, README setup, License, and Good-First-Issue signals.
2. **DevOps Pipeline Doctor**: Profiler for GitHub Actions workflows calculating wasted runner compute minutes, dependency caching (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip), concurrency cancellation, supply-chain SHA pinning, and copyleft/permissive license compliance.
3. **Multi-Repo Fleet Cockpit**: Organization-wide health overview for GitHub organizations (`/org/:org`) detecting stale repository drift, missing licenses, and fleet contributor readiness averages.
4. **Community Template & CI Studio**: Zero-token interactive generator for GitHub issue forms, PR templates, Dependabot configs, CONTRIBUTING.md guides, and GitHub Actions CI pipelines with 1-click dispatch.
5. **Next Useful Move & 1-Click Auto-Fix**: Automatically identifies the single highest-impact onboarding gap and provides complete copyable remediation patches and issue drafts.
6. **Stack-Specific Deep Health**: Automated deep scans for React 19 readiness and Next.js modern architecture (App Router, Turbopack, dynamic OpenGraph, metadata APIs).
7. **Multi-Server Edge Resilience**: Powered by Cloudflare Workers (Primary) and Vercel Edge (Mirror) with automatic health probes and client-side failover.
8. **Algofox Dev Assistant & Review**: Interactive community companion providing evidence-bound actionable feedback without evaluating private code.

## Content & Usage Boundaries

Use the canonical product and linked public policies for current information. Do not infer a repository's security, quality, contributor responsiveness, licensing sufficiency, or suitability from a score alone.
